support.title: What would help right now?
support.subtitle: Choose the option that feels most accessible. You remain in control of the pace.
support.guidedDescription: Follow a short grounding pause, then check in again.

planDescription(param=count).zero: No action has been prepared yet.
planDescription(param=count).one: Choose from the action you prepared.
planDescription(param=count).other: Choose from the $count actions you prepared.

grounding.feet: Place your feet on the floor.
grounding.observe: Notice what you feel without trying to push it away.
grounding.exhale: Breathe out longer than you breathe in.
grounding.change: Simply notice whether it rises, falls, or stays stable.
grounding.title: Give yourself a moment.
grounding.subtitle: This short pause is an aid to relaxation, not a medical rule.

strategy.title: What action can you try now?
strategy.subtitle: One small, realistic action is enough. It does not need to make the feeling disappear.
strategy.planSubtitle: Choose one of the actions you prepared for this moment.
strategy.ideasSubtitle: Choose another simple action that feels realistic right now.
strategy.empty: No action is available in this list.
strategy.timerGuidance: This timer is only a guide: you can finish sooner or take as much time as you need.

result.title(rich): How strong is your urge now?
result.subtitle: It may have increased, decreased, or stayed the same.

outcome.title: And now?
outcome.subtitle: Feel free to be honest. As always, no judgement!
outcome.label: Outcome

result.noteHint: A useful marker for next time.

complete.title: Flow complete
complete.consumedBody:
This event does not erase your progress.
You can simply note what may help next time.
complete.otherBody:
You made space between your urge and your choice.
This is a skill that grows one attempt at a time.

intensity.subtitle: Rate it out of 10. There is no wrong answer: this marker will help show how it changes.
intensity.label: Current intensity

factors.title: More details?
factors.subtitle: These optional details can help you better understand these moments.
factors.label: Contributing factors (optional)

error.start: Unable to start this support flow right now. Try again.
error.missingSession: This session is no longer available.
error.strategySave: The strategy could not be saved. Try again.
error.outcomeRequired: Choose the result that best describes the situation.
error.save: Unable to save right now. Try again in a moment.
